source.provider: Binance Spot daily klines via connected public market-data API
source.survivorship_bias_warning: Five retrospectively known assets; NOT a historically point-in-time constructed universe; not evidence of broadly generalizable profitability.

fixed_assumptions.entry: Use previous CLOSED daily candle close > maximum of the PRIOR 20 daily highs (excluding signal candle) + 0.25 * ATR14 of signal candle; execute at next day's open
fixed_assumptions.exit: Use previous CLOSED daily candle close < highest close since entry - 2 * ATR14 of prior closed candle; execute at next day's open
fixed_assumptions.transaction_cost_description: one modeled combined 15bp fee-plus-slippage on every buy and sell

acceptance_rule: Validation Sharpe > 0.6 AND Validation net return > BTC buy-and-hold net return, both after modeled costs
limitations: Metrics come from direct in-session JavaScript calculations on Binance public daily kline observations; no independent Github Actions execution of v6 has been performed.
The five selected assets are not point-in-time historical top 5 or top 20.
ATR-close-based exits are assumed executed on next daily open; no intrabar stop orders or actual fills.
This v6 is a newly specified proxy in a previously under-specified reserved family and cannot be presented as a preregistered holdout result.
A failed BTC benchmark means no Test-3 permission under the agreed rule.
